name: ThrowSpin
_intent: Forehand side-arm sling of a flat food from the right hand: from the set (disc out to the right), coil a little further back (held), stride at the lane with the left foot, hips then shoulders open, the arm slings forward flat across the body keeping the disc level and the wrist snaps it out with the arm extended forward at chest-to-shoulder height (Release); the arm follows through across the body, rear heel up, held; then back to a stand.
_reference: frisbee forehand / discus sling; release frame 21

keyframes._note: COIL: chest wound right, disc drawn further back
RELEASE: arm out forward at chest-shoulder height, wrist snapped
